A real app with its own code gains a little, as above. Shared fixes grew the framework packages too, measured with Vue, React, Preact and Solid apps of minimal size on another pre-release build: about 1.4 KB to 2.5 KB gzip more. React, Preact and Solid also carry the shared rich text renderer.

A first load now takes two files, the root and the page. Its bytes stay the same (+0.3% over 103 and 89 first loads on the two SSR apps). The next page in the same document takes one small file: 4.7 KB to 1.5 KB gzip and 5.9 KB to 0.5 KB gzip on the two pages measured. Over a logged-in walk of the SPA, dictionary bytes fell 21%.

On a small demo app, the Cloudflare Worker upload went from 241.5 KiB to 250.3 KiB gzip, on a pre-release build. Dictionaries embedded in an Edge bundle use the same root and page files, but we have not measured that embed on a large catalog.
